title: Fermentation Gravity and Attenuation Curve
dataSources: Fermentation gravity/temperature (`brew:fermentation`), kegerator pours (`kegerator:pour`), wine-cellar climate (`winecellar:reading`).
app: Fermentation sensors (Tilt/iSpindel hydrometer, temperature), kegerator flow meters and scales, and wine-cellar climate sensors via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=brew:fermentation
| timechart span=6h avg(gravity) as sg
| eventstats first(sg) as og
| eval attenuation_pct=round(100*(og-sg)/(og-1),1)
description: Charts the specific gravity of a fermenting batch and derives how far it has attenuated toward finished beer.
value: The gravity curve is the heartbeat of a fermentation; watching attenuation tells you how the yeast is really doing, day by day.
implementation: Feed a floating hydrometer (Tilt/iSpindel) into `index=personal`; review the gravity drop and attenuation across the ferment.
visualization: Line chart of specific gravity over time with attenuation percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It follows how your beer is fermenting by tracking its density, showing how far along the yeast has turned sugar into alcohol.
